_about: ASSET-002 Rootstalker STEP 3: material recipe per part (our COPIES of vanilla materials). Colours are multipliers.

body (Wolf M).albedo: read _MainTex (256) back, paint a 512 copy: repaint.json with repaint/wolf_hive_mask.png (R bark, G extremities, B veins+glow, A roots), repaint/wolf_mouth_mask.png (R wet opening, G gum band, B radiating folds) and repaint/wolf_moss_mask.png (R moss)
body (Wolf M).emission: _EmissionMap = hive mask B x blight colour; _EmissionColor white x 1.6
body (Wolf M).glossiness: raise where mouth mask R (wet opening) if the shader allows; else skip

maw lips (2 TheHive lumps).vertex colours: vertex_colors/maw.json maw_lip_* (dark inner edge) - multiply albedo

gum rows (Wolf M mouth islands 35/42 tri.material: copy of the Wolf material, _Color srgb (0.85, 0.74, 0.52)
gum rows (Wolf M mouth islands 35/42 tri.vertex colours: vertex_colors/maw.json maw_row_* (painted depth: near-black maroon inside, dark gum at the edge)

canines (Wolf M islands 12/21 tris).material: copy of hugeskull bone material, tint (0.42, 0.33, 0.19)

eyes (eye_globe): as the Brute: kit/eye/eye_globe_core_pupil_mask.png (R core emission, G pupil), base x0.18, _EmissionColor linear (1.0, 0.28, 0.04) x 10

branches (gd_king Elder islands)._MainTex: texture copy: saturation x0.2, then x(0.17, 0.145, 0.115)

biome tint (ApplyBiomeVisuals): OWNER DECISION, see previews/final_biome_blackforest_panel.png (left _Color only, right as coded with _EmissionColor = tint x2: the whole Rootstalker glows flat purple)
